title: Prototype Pollution Vulnerability

bugs.explanation: Setting `obj['__proto__']` modifies `Object.prototype`, polluting all objects. This is a security vulnerability. Always validate keys before using dynamic property assignment, or use `Object.create(null)` for key-value stores.
